statistic.group: (side, list vintage) on lv_dev; (side, debut year) on vm_dev

definitions.driver: a (head, key) pair; level_rank sits in both hitter heads
definitions.leave_one_out: V2 refit per fold with the driver withheld from its head; every other candidate and the registered weights unchanged
definitions.leave_one_in: V2 refit per fold with the driver the ONLY candidate (the admission rule still applies); a pitcher timing driver relaxes DS-Q2, which would otherwise make it the consensus order
definitions.head_rows: skill head alone, timing head alone (pitcher DS-Q2 relaxed on the timing row)
definitions.identical_to_v2: withholding a driver no fold admitted reproduces V2 exactly (admission is per key; the penalty is chosen on admitted keys); no bootstrap is drawn for such a row
definitions.slope: the DS-06 statistic per training vintage (t of z(x) in y ~ 1 + u_c + z(x)) and one pooled partial slope over every vintage that observes the driver
definitions.strata: efv_strata cells; never a consensus-FV cell

weights_diag.what: V2's fold heads re-weighted without a refit; a diagnosis, selected nowhere; the registered weights stand

counterfactual.what: current served rows at the pre-refit weights (before) against the served order (after); same heads, same inputs, only the 10-04 weights move

realized.what: the served artifact before and after the post-epoch rebuild, on rows V2 graded in both with the same consensus FV; the rebuild also merged the other lanes' code, so this is the realized change, not the refit alone

pit.consensus_only_reason: owner DS-Q2: no pitcher skill driver passed the admission rule in this fold, so pitchers take the consensus order
